items.title: US lifts naval blockade as Iran's supreme leader says Trump made deal 'out of desperation'
items.description: Iran's supreme leader says he disagrees with the deal and Donald Trump signed it "out of desperation".

items.title: Bowen: US-Iran deal raises inescapable question of what the war was for
items.description: While the human cost is clear, the Iranian regime has not just survived the war, it has been empowered.

items.title: What Iran and US get from deal and why both could struggle to keep it
items.description: BBC analysts assess the claims by both Washington and Tehran to have won a victory with the deal to end their war.

items.title: Moscow residents complain of black rain after largest Ukrainian attack hits oil refinery
items.description: A refinery and a shopping centre burned after almost 200 Ukrainian drones struck an area to the south-east of the Russian capital.

items.title: Thirty-five killed as gunmen attack Niger's biggest airport
items.description: Niger has been fighting a militant Islamist insurgency for a decade and in January suspected jihadists attacked the same airport.

items.title: Parents of Serbia's teenage school shooter given jail terms in retrial
items.description: The boy was 13 when he killed eight girls, a boy and a school guard at Vladislav Ribnikar school in Belgrade in 2023.

items.title: Hegseth renews Nato criticism and says US will review presence in Europe
items.description: The US defence secretary's move follows a US decision to scale back its commitments to a high readiness force within the alliance.

items.title: British man dies in paragliding accident in Spain
items.description: Authorities in Catalonia confirmed that the 63-year-old died in the Palau de Noguera area on Wednesday.

items.title: Suspected gang leader shot dead in flower bouquet ambush at airport
items.description: The gunmen concealed their weapons behind flowers and stuffed toys while waiting for the victim outside Guayaquil airport.

items.title: Jury fails to reach verdict in Norwegian 'hitman' trial
items.description: Johannes Natland, 19, was remanded in custody and will now face a retrial.

items.title: Obamas host star-studded opening of Chicago presidential centre
items.description: The campus opens to the public this weekend with a museum, community amenities and more to honour the 44th US president.

items.title: Bird flu kills more than 75% of baby seals on remote Australian island, study finds
items.description: Scientists say 13,000 southern elephant seal pups on Heard Island have died of the H5N1 strain.
